Buttermilk Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 7:59am

Ingredients




2 cups sugar
1 cup Crisco
4 whls eggs
3 cups cake flour, sifted with
teaspoon salt
teaspoon baking soda
1 cup buttermilk
1 teaspoon vanilla

Preparation

1 Cream sugar, Crisco and add 1 egg at a time. Sift flour, salt and baking soda into buttermilk. Add to creamed mixture; add vanilla. Bake in stem pan 1 hour at 350 degrees. Turn out on rack after cooling 10 minutes. 2 NOTE: Buttermilk equivalent - 1 cup with 1 or 2 tablespoons vinegar added to cup measure. Fill cup with sweet milk and let stand 5 minutes. 3 My Meme's recipe
